test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a circular race of 4800m, A and B start from the same point and at the same time with speeds of 36 km/h and 54 km/h. When will they meet again for the first time on the track if they are running in the opposite direction?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed in opposite direction = 36 + 54 = 90 km/h = 90 × (5/18) = 25 m/s.

Time to meet for the first time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Time = 4800 ÷ 25 = 192 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 192 second.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the circular track = 4800 m

Speed of A = 36 km/h

Speed of B = 54 km/h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/faa7231fc091da6e0b365ac3691a75486a52bee979089951a61b34bcded79ded.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction) = Speed of A + Speed of B

Time taken to meet = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

1 km/h = 5/18 m/s

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed of A in m/s = 36 × (5/18) = 10 m/s

⇒ Speed of B in m/s = 54 × (5/18) = 15 m/s

⇒ Relative Speed = 10 + 15 = 25 m/s

⇒ Time to meet = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 4800 ÷ 25

⇒ Time = 192 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 192 second.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Meeting for the first time anywhere on the track

Time = Length of track ÷ Relative Speed. The relative speed is the sum of their speeds if moving in opposite directions, and difference of their speeds if moving in the same direction.

Meeting for the first time at the starting point

Time = LCM of individual times taken to complete one full round (LCM of T₁, T₂, ...). This applies irrespective of the direction of motion.

Speed Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s directly, multiply the given speed by 5/18. Conversely, to convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.
